storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Left luggage on Level 1 of the terminal. Wheelchairs are accepted there free of charge.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: The airport car park is at 3Б Kolkhoznaya St; more spaces on Kolkhoznaya St opposite the terminal. A drop-off and pick-up zone for passengers with disabilities is set aside at the terminal ramp.
